title: ModuLuxe Bento Prep Box
description: Stop-motion and fluid commercial demonstrating modular bento snack organization, fresh fruit sorting, and seamless refrigerator storage.
overview: Produced a clean, satisfying product interaction video showing fresh blueberries, strawberries, and almonds being sorted into partitioned container compartments and stacked in a refrigerator.
challenge: Physical product video shoots for domestic housewares require staged kitchens, food stylists, and studio lighting that inflate initial ad testing costs.
solution: Modeled photorealistic bento geometries and rendered clean dynamic hand-interaction sequences using Kling AI and Runway Gen-3, upscaled to crisp 4K 60fps with Topaz AI.
